summary: Frontend-only validation completed for reference-category slideshow behavior, autoplay/manual controls, accessibility keyboard flow, responsive modal behavior, reduced-motion behavior, inquiry handoff, and image-fallback retry on the public preview URL.

integration_issues.issue: In practical automation check (switching to a second tab for >5s), slideshow counter still advanced (02/03 -> 03/03). This may indicate document-visibility pause is not consistently taking effect in runtime, or visibility state did not transition as expected in this environment.

action_items: Re-verify hidden-tab/document.visibilitychange autoplay pause behavior in real user browser conditions (especially Safari/WebKit and mobile browsers), since automation tab-switch check observed continued advancement.
Optional: add deterministic QA harness for visibility-change (or telemetry logs around setVisible/playing) to remove ambiguity between app logic and headless runtime visibility semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Reference category data mapping is correct per requirement: Glas(3), Metall(3), Holz(2), Kunststoff/Schiefer/Textil(1), with no Dr.Klein glass sign under Kunststoff.
Autoplay/manual/keyboard/thumb behavior is implemented and working as expected in primary UI flows (including manual interaction stopping autoplay and explicit play resuming).
Reduced-motion behavior is correctly initialized as non-autoplay on reload under prefers-reduced-motion, with explicit Play enabling timed advance.
Image fallback + retry UX works; one blocked glass asset displayed clear failed-image state and recovered after Erneut laden.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Most requested flows pass on https://subtle-motion-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Responsive checks passed at 390x844, 320x568, and 768x1024 with no horizontal overflow and usable controls/CTA. Real touch API was unavailable in this automation context (hasTouch disabled), so swipe validation used drag-gesture fallback.
rca of the issue: Potential RCA for hidden-page autoplay pause discrepancy: useReferenceSlideshow depends on document.hidden + visibilitychange, but headless tab-switch behavior may not always emit expected visibility transitions to the tested page. In one practical check, counter advanced while backgrounded; needs confirmation in interactive browser sessions to distinguish runtime limitation vs app bug.
